Interface Message

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Subinterfaces:
Command, Event, GameCommand, GameEvent, HeartbeatCommand, HeartbeatEvent, LobbyCommand, LobbyEvent
All Known Implementing Classes:
AutoPlayerInvokedEvent, AutoPlayerTimerStartedEvent, BoardUpdatedEvent, CardTakenEvent, CreateLobbyCommand, CurrentPlayerChangedEvent, EraChangedEvent, ErrorEvent, EventResolvedEvent, ExtraTurnEndedEvent, ExtraTurnStartedEvent, GameAbortedEvent, GameEndedEvent, GameRecoveryFailedEvent, GameSetupCompletedEvent, GameStartedEvent, GlobalTimerCancelledEvent, GlobalTimerStartedEvent, JoinLobbyCommand, LeaveLobbyCommand, LobbyDissolvedEvent, MoveTotemCommand, PhaseChangedEvent, PingCommand, PingEvent, PlayerDisconnectedEvent, PlayerLimitsInitializedEvent, PlayerLimitsUpdatedEvent, PlayerReconnectedEvent, PlayerResourceChangedEvent, PongCommand, PongEvent, ReconnectCommand, ResolveActionsCommand, SelectTotemCommand, SetUsernameCommand, TotemPlacedEvent, TotemReturnedEvent, TurnOrderEstablishedEvent, UpdatedLobbiesEvent, UpdatedLobbyEvent, UsernameResultEvent
public sealed interface Message extends Serializable permits Command, Event
Root sealed interface for all network messages exchanged between client and server. Subtypes are either Command (client → server) or Event (server → client).

Jackson polymorphic deserialization is configured via @JsonTypeInfo(Id.CLASS) at this level, but each subtype overrides it with @JsonTypeInfo(Id.NAME) for compact wire names. See JsonMessageCodecImpl for the resolution strategy.
